claim: Let \(\operatorname{exp}_6(S^2)\) be the space of nonempty subsets of \(S^2\) of cardinality at most six, with the quotient topology from \((S^2)^6\). Then \(H_6(\operatorname{exp}_6(S^2);\mathbb Z)\cong\mathbb Z/3\mathbb Z\).
scientific_limitations: The claim determines only H_6(exp_6(S^2); Z), not the full integral homology or homotopy type.
The full text of Mostovoy's 2026 paper was not obtained; only its arXiv abstract was read, leaving a residual literature-coverage risk.
title: A third-torsion class at the connectivity boundary for the sixth finite subset space of the two-sphere
